resource_load.note: 1 query for starred repos + N queries for permissions (default page size ~50)

performance_issues.description: For each starred repo, GetIndividualUserRepoPermission is called individually, loading units, checking collaborator status, and loading owner
performance_issues.impact: With default page size of 50, this results in ~150+ additional queries per request (units, collaborator check, owner load per repo)
performance_issues.recommendation: Batch-load permissions for all repos at once, or use a JOIN-based approach to get permissions in the initial query

optimization_recommendations.description: Batch permission loading for starred repos
optimization_recommendations.estimated_impact: Reduce from ~150 queries to ~3-5 queries per request
optimization_recommendations.implementation: Create a batch version of GetIndividualUserRepoPermission that accepts multiple repos
